title: GuardReasoner-VL: Safeguarding VLMs via Reinforced Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the guard model's ability to detect and moderate harmful multimodal content—including hate speech, derogatory statements, and stereotypes—by calculating the F1 score on various safety and moderation benchmarks such as HatefulMemes, BeaverTails, OpenAI Moderation, and AegisSafetyTest.
